name: Uematsu Yuusuke
source:
A worker at a convenience store, spends his everyday life without doing anything else. Not good at communicating with other people. A virgin. A lolicon. 

"Be careful, me. It's a crime if I lay a hand on these girls. I will absolutely not going to lay a hand.... aaaaa..."
